attributes.title: 2027 VCS Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Veterinary Cancer Society holds its 2027 Annual Conference September 23 to 25, 2027 in St. Louis, Missouri. It is the society's main meeting for veterinary oncology.

Recent editions included pre-conference workshops, keynote talks, specialty sessions, research abstracts, a resident review workshop and technician workshops such as cytology for veterinary technicians. The society describes its community as clinicians, researchers, trainees, technicians and industry partners.

The 2027 venue, fees and CE hours were not posted when we checked. The society's calendar lists only dates and city so far.
